workflowReleaseWorkflow.name: Onboarding Demo - Peter Jaber

comment.body:
# Welcome to Workflows!
Try pressing the play button below to run the block.

You should now see results below the previous block.
We will now use the results in this loop block to grab more detailed information.

Using the previous block's information, we will
compose an email message to send to your attached email address.

After running all the blocks in a row, this workflow
can run front-to-back with the "Run" button in the top right of the editor. If the workflow
is to your liking, you can "deploy" the workflow and "enable" it to run it on a scheduled cadence.
